C1.worst_defect: The hero is clear, but just below it the home page turns into developer jargon a first-timer can't parse: the comparison table's refund cell says "The refund stays Pending until an administrator settles it with two Admin API calls", and 'Before you start' lists "Node ^20.19 || >=22.12" and "RxDB Premium licence token (RXDB_PREMIUM)".
C1.where: home/desktop/02 (table 'Refund a sale at the till' row, 'Setting up the store' list); home/phone/04-05

C2.worst_defect: The site never says who makes VendurePOS. The only clue is an unexplained third-party domain in the demo row ("All it sends is anonymous usage events to ph.wcpos.com"), and the footer's "Built with TallyUI. For Medusa, see MedusaPOS" doesn't answer it either, so a newcomer can't tell who stands behind the product.
C2.where: home/desktop/02 table last row and footer

C3.worst_defect: The quick start runs to nine steps and asks the reader to absorb a naming mismatch ("The plugin's code names say Tally, not VendurePOS: TallyPosPlugin, the TallyPosSell permission and the /tally/v1 routes"). Step 5 also has a leftover collapsible, "If your store already allows vendurepos.vercel.app", that refers to an old domain the reader has never seen.
C3.where: quick-start/desktop/01 step 2; quick-start/desktop/03 and phone/06 step 5 collapsible

C4.worst_defect: The public changelog is raw internal release notes: "GET /tally/v1/info advertises order.create 1–5 (ADR 0005)" and "order.create v5 custom lines are real order lines on a plugin-owned, disabled 'POS custom item' variant". It cites ADRs and protocol versions with no plain-language summary per bullet, beyond the one 'In short' line.

C5.worst_defect: 'What it does today' is inconsistent: the first two features sit in bordered cards with buttons, and the next eight are plain unboxed text in a two-column list. There's no image or icon between the hero screenshot and the table, so the middle of the page reads as a wall of grey text.

C6.worst_defect: On the phone, the hero screenshot shows only the top of the till: two product tiles and a category row clipped at "Gif", with no cart or total in view. It doesn't show a sale the way the desktop image does, and the caption "A sale in progress" falls off the bottom of the slice.

C7.worst_defect: Mobile LCP is 2.4–2.5 s on both audited pages (quick-start's largest-contentful-paint scores only 0.89), with 53 KiB of unused JS and render-blocking requests flagged on the home page. Titles, share card, JSON-LD, llms.txt, search, sitemap and the 404 page are all in order.

overall_worst.defect: After a clear hero, the rest of the home page talks to someone who already runs a Vendure server. The table and 'Before you start' use 'two Admin API calls', 'Node ^20.19 || >=22.12' and 'RxDB Premium licence token (RXDB_PREMIUM)', and the page never says who makes VendurePOS. A first-time visitor half-sure what Vendure is loses the thread, and the demo stays the only clear next step.
overall_worst.fix: On the home page, cut the refund cell to "No, not yet: refund in the Vendure Dashboard (see Limitations)". Move the Node range and the RxDB self-hosting note to the Overview or Connect a till page, and add one footer line saying who builds and maintains VendurePOS.
